app.title: Lafia Chat AI — Munnyambulizi w'ebyobulamu ow'ekyama
consent.title: Ekifo ekikuumi ku bibuuza by'amazima go.
consent.subtitle: Lafia munnyambulizi w'ebyobulamu eri abakyala n'abawala. Buuza ku mubiri gwo, okutunga, olubuto, enkola y'okuzaala n'obulamu — mu lulimi lwo.
consent.promise1Body: Tetubuuza linnya lyo, nnamba ya ssimu oba imeyilo.
consent.promise2Body: Tewali kintu kitera kusigibwa okuggyako osalawo okukisiga ku kifaananyi kino.
consent.promise3Body: Kozesa Fuluma amangu oba sangula emboozi zo ekiseera kyonna.
consent.notDiagnosis: Ntegeera nti Lafia awa amawulire ag'obulamu aga bulijjo so si kulamula ndwadde.
consent.emergencyNote: Mu mbeera ey'akabenje, tuukirira omukisa w'ebyobulamu oba obuyambi bw'akabenje amangu.
consent.quickExitHint: Amagezi: nyiga Escape emirundi ebiri okufuluma amangu.
chat.welcomeSubtitle: Mbuuza ku byonna ebikukwatako mu bulamu. Nnaaddamu okuva mu bulagirizi bwa WHO era ndaga ensibuko.
chat.suggestion2: Nkola ki ez'okuzaala eziriwo gye ndi?
chat.suggestion4: Nnina okweraliikirira — nnyinza okufuna obuyambi wa?
chat.saveChats: Tereka emboozi zange ku kifaananyi kino
chat.saveChatsHint: Kizikiddwa bulijjo. Ziterekerwa mu browser yino yokka, tezitumibwa ku server.
chat.deleteConfirm: Sangula emboozi zonna eziterekeddwa mu browser yino?
chat.pressEscAgain: Nyiga Escape emirundi ebiri okufuluma Lafia.
chat.disclaimer: Lafia awa amawulire ag'obulamu aga bulijjo, so si kulamula ndwadde. Ku bubonero obw'akabenje, noonya obujjanjabi amangu.
chat.voiceUnavailable: Okuliriza tekuli ku lulimi luno mu browser yo.
chat.micUnsupported: Okwogera mu maikiro tekukola mu browser yino.
chat.quickExitAria: Fuluma amangu mu Lafia odde ku mutimbagano ogutali kukwatagana
privacy.title: Ekyama
privacy.noAccountBody: Osobola okukozesa byonna awatali kuyingira. Tetubuuza linnya lyo, nnamba ya ssimu oba imeyilo.
privacy.saveTitle: Tereka emboozi zange ku kifaananyi kino
privacy.saveBody: Kizikiddwa bulijjo. Bwe kikolebwa, emboozi ziterekerwa mu browser yino yokka. Tezitumibwa ku server yaffe.
privacy.deleteBody: Kino kiggyawo emboozi eziterekeddwa mu browser yino. Tekisobola kuddizibwa.
privacy.quickExitBody: Okunyiga Fuluma amangu oba Escape emirundi ebiri kuggula omutimbagano ogutali kukwatagana era kiggyawo ekiseera kino. Akabokisi ka Ddayo tekirikudda Lafia.
privacy.locationTitle: Ekifo kyo kisigala ku kifaananyi kyo
privacy.locationBody: Zuula obujjanjabi kozesa ekifo kyo omulundi gumu, mu browser yo, okuteekateeka obujjanjabi obumpi. Tekitumibwa oba kuterekebwa.
care.title: Zuula obujjanjabi okumpi nange
care.subtitle: Bino bya kyakulaga. Bika mu nafasi ya obujjanjabi obukakasiddwa nga togannaba kutandika.
care.locationDenied: Olukusa lw'ekifo lukyiddwa. Okyasobola okulaba obujjanjabi obwa kyakulaga.
care.locationHint: Ekifo kyo kikozesebwa omulundi gumu ku kifaananyi kino era tekikumibwa oba kuterekebwa.
care.chwBody: Saba essimu ey'okuddamu okuva ku mukisa w'ebyobulamu ow'ekitundu. Ekyokulabirako kino tekisindika bisaba bwe kityo.
care.chwNotConnected: Okusaba essimu ey'okuddamu tekukwatiddwa ku kino.
care.emergencyNote: Nnamba ya akabenje eya kyakulaga. Kakasa nnamba entuufu ey'ekitundu kyo nga togannaba kutandika.
care.placeholderNote: Amannya, nnamba ne ssaawa zonna wammanga za kyakulaga. Zirina okukyusibwa n'obujjanjabi obukakasiddwa.
care.locationAria: Kozesa ekifo kyange okuteekateeka obujjanjabi ku lugendo
